verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Excel or Google Sheets add-in, and no live, two-way sync between spreadsheets and cfo.ai. What is documented is a connected Google Sheet or Drive file imported into the cfo.ai Model, which only flows into cfo.ai, and a one-off download of a Page as an Excel workbook. Neither is a spreadsheet add-in that pulls live data in and pushes edits back, so both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, a bi-directional Excel or Google Sheets add-in pulls live data into my spreadsheets and pushes edits back
